_comment: Typortrait gallery catalog. collections -> sections -> items. Each item: id (stable, used in checkout + art filename), title, words (the text the portrait is woven from), art (provenance of the base image), text (provenance of the words). Art masters live at /static/gallery/art/<id>.png.

collections.title: Portraits of Christ
collections.blurb: The face of Christ, revealed in the names and titles that belong to him.

items.title: Compassionate Savior
items.subject: Jesus Christ
items.words: CHRIST SAVIOR COMPASSION MERCY LOVE GRACE GENTLE FORGIVENESS TENDER HEALING SHEPHERD REDEEMER
